s02166.summary: The Okonjo family sits in silent, rigid waiting outside the hospice room.
Chidi and Ngozi bicker over minutes while Emeka begs for peace.
Mrs. Etim recalls Grandmother Ada eating jollof last Sunday; the family quietly agrees.
A nurse's hand appears and vanishes; the family stands together facing the closed door.

s00752.summary: Perpetua, alone in the flooded kitchen, trades barbs with the amused phone caller.
At the caller's urging, Perpetua sees a coat hanging from the third tree.
Perpetua coaxes the caller into giving his name over whisky.
Roscoe Hale admits he buried his brother Edmund in the orchard.
A man silhouetted by lightning appears in the kitchen doorway and the candle dies.

s00530.summary: Deke drags Ollie toward the door while Miriam swings a crowbar at the dark above.
Something shifts overhead, and the family finds the door chained from outside.
The ladder creaks slowly as Ollie goes silent and stares at the door.

s02266.summary: Anxious Ronan complains about the wait while lawyer Constance dryly calms him before the verdict.
Constance fixes his folder and coaches him on how to carry and present himself.
She gives him her handkerchief and tells him to look at the jury.
Ronan asks about her experience; she answers tersely and finally drinks her coffee.

s01884.summary: At bingo night, Lorraine needles her son Darnell about his missed visits.
Lorraine reveals she called the depot and learned Darnell quit in May.
A county clerk appears at the table seeking Darnell's signature for missed hearings.
Darnell signs and admits he lost his apartment and van.
Lorraine stands and orders Darnell home; he explodes, flinging his cards.
Lorraine says he is her son; Mags softly calls bingo.

s01947.summary: The crew hurriedly loads gold from the looted vault as the clock runs down.
Camille reveals only eighteen of thirty bars remain, taken by someone with a key.
Rashid presses on who knew the plan and stares down Sven.
Camille proposes keeping eighteen bars and letting the thief keep twelve, then time runs out.

s01622.summary: Five soldiers lie on a pagoda roof at dawn, watching the treeline.
Marchetti spills ammunition boxes down the tiles and into the paddy with a splash.
A distant shot chips a tile by Lindqvist's head and everyone flattens.
Okonkwo stands and waves at the mist; a white scarf answers.
Relief spreads as the soldiers lower their guard before a second shot.
Under fire, the squad slides off the roof and into the water.
Mist closes over the roof and silence returns.

s01992_0.summary: Climbers huddle in the ice cave as Hannelore orders them to rope up and Toby complains.
Ingrid's photo triggers a scuffle that knocks Gideon onto the stove, putting it out.
A groan from the ice overhead tells the climbers it is not wind.
A crack sounds, they scatter, and the ice roof collapses.

s02363.summary: A quiet rooftop garden where doctor, patient and daughter sit together.
Dr. Fairweather plainly tells Penhaligon the cancer has spread and he has weeks.
She turns planning into hope by suggesting he finally see Lisbon.
Called away, the doctor is thanked for sitting and touches his shoulder.

s02217.summary: Dr. Kemp and tech Preston prepare to operate on an anaesthetized retriever.
Isadora opens the dog and pulls out a twisted blue cloth.
Mr. Bell recognizes the sock as his late wife Margaret's.
Isadora closes the incision while Preston wipes his eyes, the dog having eaten the sock in grief.

s00973.summary: Wynfred and Sable question why knight Lucan has come for the queen bee.
Lucan admits his orders were to take the queen, alive or dead; the king has been silent.
Lucan refuses to kill the queen and vows to warn the king; Sable insists on going too.
Wynfred stops their quarrel and sends the two off together.

s01807.summary: A wounded woman barricades herself inside the dead radio studio.
She explores the booth, switches on the ON AIR light, and finds a badge with her name.
A recorded voice of Nell's own warns her not to trust what speaks in her voice.
Nell kills the red light and goes dark as something slides in the corridor.
A calm voice in her own tone begs to be let in; Nell silently refuses.

s01151.summary: Office staff trade morning pleasantries and jokes before a mysterious all-hands.
Scott spins consultant Prakash's visit as an opportunity as staff fear audits and layoffs.
Prakash shows that Henderson and others are already terminated.
Kendra points out Scott's name tops the list; he gulps Barry's tea in shock.

s01435.summary: Hollis sits alone in the ruined saloon, talking to the empty room and his cracked reflection.
Dora calls him out from outside; weary Hollis answers from the doorway.
Dora pushes through the doors, rifle on her back, and they trade dry barbs.
Dora drinks from his cup and demands the horse he owes her.

s00435.summary: Rosalind claims a dryer from Dario while her mother and others chip in.
Rosalind lends quarters and finally gives Dario the machine.

s02264.summary: Agnes serves soup calmly and refuses to hear Fothergill's news until after eating.
Fothergill reveals creditors demand four thousand pounds; Edmund suggests selling land.
Fothergill proposes a marriage to a Bath widower to settle the debt.
It dawns that the gentleman wants Edmund; Agnes feigns calm and offers more soup.
Edmund retreats to the fire and wipes his eyes while Agnes resumes eating.

s00559.summary: Six conspirators crouch awkwardly behind furniture in the dental office awaiting Grandma's surprise party.
The door chimes twice with nobody entering while they whisper and fumble.
Grandma Rosemary walks in on the ambush and says she thought it was tomorrow.

s01209.summary: A party crosses a crystal forest while Pip asks if the trees sing.
A deep thrum shakes the forest and the party forms a protective triangle around Pip.
A shard-creature appears and sweeps Barrow, Kestrel and Imogen off their feet.
Pip stops the fight, hums the creature's song, and it kneels, softening to gold.
The creature touches Pip's forehead, a rainbow floods the clearing and the forest sings.

s00504.summary: The final bocce match is tied; Aldo rolls close and the referee measures.
Cormac hurls his ball, scattering the cluster and sparking a brawl that Testa halts.

s01203.summary: Odette haggles with the pawnbroker over her wedding ring, getting him to fifty dollars.
She takes the money, then puts the ring back on and returns the cash.

s00701.summary: Teens at the windmill hole trade glances while Dolores announces closing time.
Skye's putt fails, Marcus laughs, and Jamal quietly hands her another ball.

s00647.summary: Inspector Mbeki questions fishmonger Wei-Ling about a bag found in her ice.
Mbeki notices Ken hiding behind the tarp and invites anyone to claim the bag.
Wei-Ling slides the bag over; Mbeki makes her open it.
The bag holds keys and a photograph; Wei-Ling identifies her son.

s00915.summary: Gloria and Raymond warmly fuss over Claire in the kitchen before her trip.
Claire announces she gave up the apartment and quit her job.
Claire tells her stunned parents she is sick.
Raymond and Gloria pledge to fight it together; Gloria holds her daughter's face.

s00463.summary: Barnaby fumbles with a marker and announces nobody is getting fired.
He announces a flat org chart with no managers, himself included.
Odalys removes her headphones and walks out while he keeps smiling.

s01233.summary: Nadira rehearses her opening statement alone to the empty jury box.
A cough reveals retired bailiff Elias watching from the back row.
Elias critiques her opening word and persuades her to start with the weather.
Nadira redelivers her opening about the rainy night; Elias approves.
She bows her head, and Elias resumes mopping while she mutters about weather.

s00323.summary: Four people stuck in a stalled gondola squabble over rescue times and Pilar's dwindling battery.

s00813.summary: Arnold tunes his late wife's piano while estranged Josefina lingers coldly in the doorway.
Josefina enters and speaks of their loneliness and her mother's ear for tuning.
Asked how the room sounded when her mother left, Arnold plays the flat note.
Josefina tunes the flat A true; he watches her and they accept tea.
